description: Presidential Secretariat - Amendment to the Duties & Functions of the Ministers Published in Gaz. Ex. Ord. No. 1897/15 of 18.01.2015
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific personnel references (President Maithripala Sirisena) and detailed portfolio responsibilities, including amendments to ministerial functions and the transfer of specific institutions between ministries. The content includes both "who" (the President exercising constitutional powers) and "what" (detailed changes to ministerial portfolios, specific institutions being moved between ministries, and references to specific Acts). This meets the criteria for Hybrid (Type 3) as it combines government personnel with detailed portfolio descriptions.
